name: Sol Yoon
source:
"I always think of you when I write songs. They always turn out gentle that way."

An unknown idol.

During the winter break of his 3rd year in middle school, he met the protagonist, who was was the only one cheering for his impulsive street performance. Afterwards, he entered her high school and they formed a good senior-junior relationship. There were hard times, but he thought their happy and joyful high school life would continue...
Why did this "incident" happen to us?
